The original single-pair odds factor has expectation 1+(qplus-qminus)*(omega-1)/(omega+1); independent pairs and conditional averaging give the displayed block power.
The score-sign decomposition uses fixed odds and H<=1; every wrong crossing is dominated by a single oriented nonnegative supermartingale, while equality uses the whole mixture.
Under margin-only policies and the stated nonleaking future-probability assumption, conditional pairing laws factor across blocks; finite fixed weights commute with conditional expectation.

kappa=(p+q)^2/(4pq) and centered-overlap CGF yield log H=CGF-(T-2*Kplus*Kminus/m)*log(kappa)/2. Intersecting with log H<=0 is valid.
